$Comment: Extends the jar's own Sawmill.json (RPG Stations), which stays live untouched; this ExtensionAsset adds to it additively via Target.Station. What this extension carries: (1) Loot.Lootables -> this pack's own SawmillLuckTiers lootable, the MMO-luck tier ladder (see that file's own $Comment for the loot-side rationale); (2) Loot.Rolls[0] -> the MMO-luck-scaled bonus-copy roll below. Nothing else: no Xp, no Puppet, no Custody. Xp is deliberately absent: Work.Xp appends rather than replaces (an unkeyed array), and the jar's own Sawmill.json already authors Work.Xp [{WOODCUTTING 8.0},{CRAFTING 4.0}]; re-adding WOODCUTTING here would double the effective total to 16.0/cycle instead of adding a genuinely new skill. To re-tune the sawmill's XP, edit the jar's Work.Xp; an extension is for adding a new skill, never re-adding one the base already grants. Bonus-copy roll: the jar's own SawmillFinds.json carries a tool_power-scaled bonus-copy roll, and this roll adds a second one scaled off MMO luck instead, on the reasoning that the two scale on different axes and both should fire: the jar's stays untouched and scales off held-tool power, this one scales off MMO luck, so a better hatchet and a luckier woodcutter each earn their own independent extra plank. The roll is BasePercent 0 with a single unweighted mmoskilltree:station_luck AddFactor and no CapPercent, so effective chance is exactly the player's aggregate station luck in percent, and max luck reaches a guaranteed proc (RollEvaluator's absent-CapPercent default of 100 is the natural single-roll ceiling). The explicit "Trigger": "Cycle" matches Roll#effectiveTrigger's own reader default (behavior is identical either way) but stating it matches the jar's SawmillFinds convention and documents that BonusOutputCopies is only meaningful on a Cycle trigger. Extension Rolls are additive onto the base station's Loot (ExtensionCatalog#mergeLoot unions Lootables and Rolls); SawmillLuckTiers.json proves the mechanism from the Lootables side, this roll exercises the inline-Rolls side of the same LootRef.
